templates.heading: Templates
templates.emptyHint: Save the current note as a template to get started.

encryption.heading: Encryption
encryption.lockedDesc: The note body is encrypted. Enter the password to unlock.
encryption.unlockedDesc: The note body is stored in plain text. You can lock it to protect its contents.
encryption.enterPassword: Enter password to lock the note:
encryption.warning:
⚠️ WARNING: If you forget this password, the note CANNOT be recovered. There is no backdoor, no recovery option, and no way to reset it. The encrypted data will remain unreadable forever.

Are you absolutely sure you want to continue?
encryption.cannotLockNew: Cannot lock a new note. Save it first.
encryption.cannotLockNewDesc: Save the note first, then you can lock it.
encryption.cannotLockEmptyDesc: Cannot lock an empty note. Add some content first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure how LemonNote looks and behaves.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Choose a theme preset, light/dark mode, background texture, and interface density.
appearance.previewDesc: Current theme applied to this page.

writing.title: Writing defaults
writing.desc: Default font, size, line spacing, and width for new notes. Per-note settings still override these.
writing.hideTitleLabel: Hide the note title in reader view
writing.hideTitleDesc: When enabled, new notes will not show the large title above the note body

language.title: Language & digits
language.desc: Interface language, text direction of the app frame, and how numbers look.
language.digits: Digits used for dates and numbers
language.dirAuto: Follows the language (Arabic opens the interface right-to-left)

editor.title: Editor
editor.desc: Autosave timing, spell checking, and default writing direction.
editor.spellCheckLabel: Enable browser spell check in editor
editor.spellCheckDesc: Red squiggly lines under misspelled words.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.desc: LemonNote uses three font families. Download them locally so the app works completely offline.
fonts.howTo: To bundle fonts locally, download the woff2 files for the weights above from Google Fonts and place them in
fonts.thenLocal: Then the app will use local @font-face rules instead of the Google Fonts CDN.
fonts.copied: Font download URLs copied to clipboard.
fonts.bundledNote: Fonts are bundled locally. The app works offline.
fonts.needed: Inter (300-600 variable), Instrument Serif (400, 400i), JetBrains Mono (400-500 variable) — all woff2

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: All keyboard shortcuts in the app. Customization is not available yet.

backup.title: Backup
backup.desc: Export or import your entire vault. Set a reminder to back up regularly.

import.title: Import
import.desc: Import Markdown files, text files, or an entire Obsidian vault. Subfolders become note folders.
import.filesDesc: Select one or more Markdown or text files. Wikilinks [[...]], tags #tag, and front matter are preserved. Image embeds ![[image.png]] are converted to attachments.
import.folderDesc: Select a folder containing .md files. Subfolder structure is preserved as note folders. Obsidian-style wikilinks, embeds, tags, and front matter are handled automatically.
import.preserve: Preserve folder structure as note folders

storage.title: Storage
storage.desc: Manage how images and files are stored in your notes.
storage.moveTitle: Move embedded pictures out of notes
storage.moveDesc: Finds base64-encoded images in all notes, converts them to attachments stored separately, and updates the notes to reference the attachments. This reduces note size and improves performance.
storage.warn: A backup is recommended before converting. This cannot be undone.
storage.infoDesc: Attachments are stored in the local database (_files store) and included in backups.

updates.title: Updates
updates.desc: LemonNote checks for updates automatically on startup. You can also check manually. Updates are downloaded from GitHub Releases and verified with a cryptographic signature.
updates.autoCheckLabel: Check for updates on app startup
updates.autoCheckDesc: LemonNote will check for updates when you open the app.
updates.onlyTauri: Only works in the installed app
updates.latest: You are on the latest version.
updates.aboutDesc: Updates are signed and verified. The app will never update without your explicit confirmation.

mirror.title: Mirror to folder
mirror.desc: Automatically write every note as a .md file to a folder on disk. One-way only (app → disk). Updates after saves (debounced).
mirror.enabledDesc: Write notes to the mirror folder when they are saved.
mirror.autoMirrorDesc: Automatically mirror notes after a short delay when you save. Disable to only mirror manually.
mirror.folderDesc: Choose where to write the markdown files. Subfolders mirror your note folders. Attachments go in an 'attachments' subfolder.
mirror.mirrorNowDesc: Write all notes to the mirror folder immediately.
mirror.onlyTauri: Only works in the installed app
mirror.folderRequired: Please select a mirror folder first

window.title: Window
window.desc: Window behavior settings (only available in the installed app).
window.alwaysOnTopDesc: When enabled, the LemonNote window will stay on top of other windows
window.onlyTauri: Only works in the installed app

ai.title: AI Assist
ai.desc: Configure an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to enable AI actions in the ribbon (Translate, Summarize, Fix grammar, Continue writing). Nothing is sent unless you click an AI button.
ai.enabledDesc: When enabled, AI actions appear in the Home ribbon tab. Requires a valid endpoint, model, and API key.
ai.endpointDesc: Base URL of your OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Must end with /v1.
ai.modelDesc: Model name to use (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o, llama3). Must match what your endpoint supports.
ai.apiKeyDesc: Your API key. Stored locally in plain text. Click the shield icon for details.
ai.warningTitle: Your API key and data leave this computer
ai.warningText1: When you use AI features, your note text and the API key are sent to the configured endpoint over the internet.
ai.warningText2: The API key is stored in your browser's localStorage in plain text (not encrypted).
ai.warningText3: Only enable this if you trust the endpoint and accept these risks.
ai.warningText4: You can disable AI at any time to stop all network calls. The key remains stored until you clear it.

error.notEnabled: AI is not enabled. Go to Settings > AI to configure it.
error.emptyResponse: The AI returned an empty response.
